description: One-call disclosure evidence (EU AI Act Art 50 dialect): digests the disclosure text LOCALLY, signs an action record with your key, and the public ledger counter-signs it into your per-signer hash chain. No API key needed — the first call self-provisions a free signer-keyed account, except when your key is already registered to an API-key account (409) or the daily provisioning caps are reached (429; https://tersign.ai/pricing).

agentId.description: stable identifier for the disclosing agent — keep it constant across calls so one chain accumulates per agent

kind.description: what was disclosed: 'ai-interaction' = the user was told they are talking to an AI; 'synthetic-content' = output was marked machine-generated. Defaults to 'ai-interaction'

resourceUrl.description: absolute URL of the surface the disclosure was presented on, when there is one

text.description: the disclosure text as presented — digested locally, never transmitted

name: record_disclosure
title: Record counter-signed disclosure
